title: Quaternary splice models at 1000
question: what changes if the event at 1000 splices into four?

verdict.conclusion: four new carriers, four total branches, and four internal states at 1000 all give coherent finite completions, both alone and after the ternary events. The bounded-window zeros remain on-line, but every path retains the escaping-quartet obstruction.

fourState.scalarConsequence: a symmetric scalar completion sees only the invariant mean channel

populationConvention: four-new and four-total replace the existing 1000 cohort by size four or three. Four-state leaves the base population unchanged. In the combined scope, the selected ternary model at 100, 666 and 999 is retained.
delayLaw: the 1000 depth is log_10(1000)=3, shifted to four in the reindexed origin model; it has its own clock and chronological age N-3 or equal local ticks N
